info.name: Global car management API
info.description:
All API routes, organized like backend/routes/api.php.

How to use:
1. Select the "Global car managment env" environment (base_url = http://localhost:8000/api).
2. Seed demo data: docker compose exec backend php artisan migrate:fresh --seed
3. Run "1. Auth > Login as Client / Agency / Admin" (password: password). Tokens are saved automatically.
4. Run "2. Catalogue > Cities" and "Cars" to fill {{city_id}} and {{car_id}}.

Each folder already uses the right token. Requests that create or list things save the ids used by the next requests.
